name: How long does a typical kitchen plumbing upgrade project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical kitchen plumbing upgrade project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a typical kitchen plumbing upgrade project varies significantly based on the scope of work. A simple faucet replacement might take a few hours, while a comprehensive upgrade involving new drain lines, sink relocation, or appliance installation could take several days to a week. Factors like unexpected structural issues or specialized fixture availability can also influence the timeline. Frasheski Construction provides clear project timelines and manages potential delays proactively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies: a few hours for a faucet to several days for comprehensive upgrades. Scope of work and unforeseen issues impact the timeline.
